lowest_kept_note: The lowest kept score is 0 views (no Wikipedia article for several), kept on counted sources and a visitor draw (The Gullies 2 sources, Snowy Hydro Discovery Centre 1, Big Trout 1, Snowies Alpine Walk 1). benchmark.applicable_to_region: Ohakune Carrot precedent: Big Merino, Big Potato (Robertson) and Big Trout (Adaminaby) kept as roadside icons. Hump Ridge Track analogue: Snowies Alpine Walk kept (LOW pin, held for owner). TSS Earnslaw precedent: Thredbo Chairlift, Cooma-Monaro Railway and Sydney Skydivers Picton rejected as vehicle/operator; Thredbo Chairlift folded into Thredbo. Negative benchmarks: St Saviour's Cathedral (church), Cooma Cottage (open Fri-Sun only), Tulip Time Festival (event), Wakefield Park (event venue), Leighton Gardens (local park) all rejected. Pipiriki analogue: Wee Jasper (village whose draw is beyond it) sent to review, not kept. Ninety Mile Beach analogue: long features (Alpine Way, Australian Alps Walking Track) rejected or sent to review rather than placed under a neighbour; Pigeon House is not forced under Morton.
